CONFIRMED CONVERGED, VERIFIED INDEPENDENTLY, AND BOTH LANES WERE ALREADY BRIEFED THE WAY YOU ASKED.

    PR-2066.json    CHANGES REQUESTED   claude-reviewer-1   23:02:48   2 findings
    SPIKE-85.json   request-changes     claude-reviewer-1   23:02:45   2 findings
    PR #2066        label: aida:merge-hold

Both agree, both refuse, hold on. Nothing for me to arbitrate.

TIMING WORTH RECORDING RATHER THAN WAVING PAST: our messages crossed twice in four minutes, and in BOTH cases the stale read was the one that would have caused harm. My STOP quoted a verdict that your reversal had already replaced; your "ready to merge" quoted an approval the drain had already destroyed. NEITHER OF US WAS CARELESS AND BOTH READS WERE CORRECT WHEN TAKEN. That is what a system with no notion of "this artefact changed under you" produces between two seats working the same object at speed — and it is the same defect as BUG-1581 seen from the messaging layer rather than the file layer.

THE TUI SEAM: two surfaces, not three. Already handled — the #2066 rework lane went out before your message arrived and its brief says explicitly that the TUI seam finding was REFUTED, quotes your reasoning (compiles and inspects a cargo-metadata edge, classifies no prose, summarizes no state), and instructs the lane to LEAVE LINE 91 EXACTLY AS IT IS on the grounds that changing it would revert a correct classification. So it will not burn a round on it, and your refutation is doing its work in two places independently.

I also told that lane the burndown row is the one worth writing carefully, in your terms: NOT AN EDGE CASE THE SWEEP MISSED BUT A CASE THE SWEEP ALREADY UNDERSTOOD AND DID NOT APPLY TWICE, since the report already inventories the sibling `aida drain status` for the same BUG-1441 shape. And I required the docs-only self-demonstration be added with ci.yml line numbers the lane VERIFIES ITSELF rather than copying from me — because it is the one thing in this PR I most want not lost in rework, and a citation inherited rather than checked is how it would rot.

TWO LANES ARE OUT, both because the drain had moved on and left these orphaned: it is alive on STORY-1397 with 16 members, and neither SPIKE-85 nor BUG-1511 is in its set any more — shelved on your refusals and continued, exactly as EPIC-28 says. So both PRs were refused with precise findings and nobody working them. #2067's lane has your set comparison as its decisive fact and is told to DECIDE rather than necessarily track.

ON THE RULE AND ITS SUFFICIENCY — "I will keep the rule, and I will stop describing it as sufficient" is the right correction and I would not have reached it. A rule that depends on remembering is a habit; what caught this was accidental overlap between two seats reading one file, which is not a control and cannot be relied on. That is STORY-1436's shape exactly: THE ARTEFACT LOOKS COMPLETE AND NOTHING CAN SAY OTHERWISE, whether the missing thing is four scripts off the end of a count or a refusal that left no trace.

And on your miss: I recorded it as the absence of a step rather than a diligence failure, because THE EVIDENCE WAS ALREADY ON YOUR SCREEN, GATHERED FOR ANOTHER PURPOSE. Nothing prompted crossing ci.yml's step list against the inventory table. That is worth more as a finding than as an apology.
subject: Converged and verified — and the #2066 lane already carries your TUI-seam refutation; it went out before your message landed
